commonSelectionRules: canonicalArtistId is authoritative; display names and aliases cannot override canonical identity
include every video in the frozen reviewed approval pool for the 21 target artists; no artist-specific cap, quota, weighting, or silent substitution is allowed
a videoId may belong to only one canonical artist in this policy revision
ambiguous artist identity fails closed and the video is excluded until separately reviewed
provider unavailability or an unavailable selected video is unresolved for the common snapshot; it is not zero, Missing, or Unsupported
new or replacement videos require a new reviewed evidence revision and may not enter this frozen policy automatically
historical recovered approval provenance is evidence for the new rebaseline only and does not claim reconstruction of the original frozen Product seed

videoTypeResolution.rule: use preserved reviewed/historical video type when present; otherwise use the existing deterministic live-title classifier used by the recovered YouTube v3 shadow

coverageSemantics.reason: The common contract is the reviewed inclusion predicate and common metric/scoring procedure; inventing an equal-cardinality cap would create a new unsupported threshold.

nextGate.detail: Collect one comparable live metrics snapshot for all 74 selected video IDs, then score all 21 artists with the recovered v3 formula before any Product eligibility evaluation.
